scope: Initial audit of official manufacturer/importer dealer locators; representative records only, not a complete production seed.

statusLegend.verified: Current first-party Polish manufacturer/importer source was retrieved.
statusLegend.partial: Official locator exists, but dealer payload was unavailable, dynamic, blocked, incomplete, or not fully attributable.
statusLegend.unverified: No valid current Polish first-party locator was established.

locators.format: JS map plus crawlable per-dealer HTML detail pages under /dealer-locator/{city}/{slug}/
locators.acquisition: Discover detail URLs from rendered map/search indexing, then parse HTML fields: name, telephone, email, address and Google Maps coordinates.
locators.notes: Akamai may return 403 to curl/browser; clean extraction of indexed detail pages works.

locators.format: Nuxt/JS store map; HTML shell exposes filters but not Polish store rows
locators.acquisition: Render page and inspect Nuxt network requests; importer fallback is official Motor-Land contact/store page.
locators.notes: Polish site identifies Motor-Land as local organization; Motor-Land states it is exclusive importer.

locators.format: Concrete CMS HTML plus client-side Google map, country/voivodeship/city and sales/service filters
locators.acquisition: Browser/network inspection required; static extraction returns controls but not marker records.
locators.notes: Canonical first-party locator confirmed by sitemap.
Current response rendered an empty application body in the audit environment; do not reuse masked or dealer-site-only values from src/lib/dealers.ts.

locators.format: Server-rendered Super Store Finder HTML plus Google map; 215 records visible in HTML
locators.acquisition: Parse repeated name/address/region/tel/maps-coordinate blocks from HTML; normalize only explicit postcodes.
locators.notes: The locator verifies Junak outlets. It does not label records as Cyclone outlets, so Cyclone coverage remains unverified and must not be inferred. Legacy /dealerzy/ resolves to this page.

locators.format: AEM React/Mapbox app with JSON endpoints
locators.acquisition: GET JSON; dealer endpoint should return structured records and qualification endpoint returns JSON taxonomy.
locators.notes: Dealer endpoint returned {status.success:false, data:""} during audit; qualification endpoint worked. Retry later rather than backfilling from third parties.

locators.format: Nuxt/JS store map; HTML shell exposes Dealer/Service filters
locators.acquisition: Render and capture Nuxt/API traffic; official importer fallback is Motor-Land.
locators.notes: No store rows appeared in static extraction.

No nationwide first-party locator was found on qjmotor.pl in this pass. Motor-Land separately states it is exclusive importer and links qjmotor.com.pl; importer/domain ownership should be reconciled before a full import.

locators.acquisition: Parse Poland contact block from HTML.
locators.notes: Official page names Moto-Trip Kraków and phone/email but publishes no street address; /pl/dealers is a 404, so no complete dealer row was emitted.

locators.format: Magento/JavaScript store locator with Romet/Prorowery and Dealer filters
locators.acquisition: Render and inspect Magento XHR/GraphQL; static HTML is an application shell.
locators.notes: Page title and search presentation are bicycle-oriented; motorcycle authorization is not established per marker. Do not import generic Romet bicycle shops as motorcycle dealers.

locators.format: Server-side regional list plus official dealer subdomains; regional URLs use /moto/dealerzy/{regionCode}, e.g. /MA
locators.acquisition: Parse list/detail HTML; direct locator requests may return 403, while official dealer subdomain contact pages are crawlable.
locators.notes: Search result and first-party dealer subdomain corroborated MonsterBike.

locators.format: WordPress HTML embedding public Google My Maps
locators.acquisition: Download KML for names and coordinates; current KML descriptions are blank, so obtain full addresses/phones only from additional first-party importer pages.
locators.notes: KML contained 33 placemarks at audit time.

locators.format: JS/legacy map plus crawlable per-dealer HTML detail pages under /dealer-locator/{city}/{slug}/
locators.acquisition: Discover detail URLs then parse HTML fields and map coordinates.
locators.notes: The locator shell is sparse in static extraction, but official detail pages are complete.

locators.format: JavaScript map application with product/service and postcode/city filters
locators.acquisition: Render, select motorcycle/service filters and capture network response.
locators.notes: No dealer records are in static HTML; do not treat the existing masked src/lib/dealers.ts values as verification.

locators.format: Invalid source for current brand audit
locators.acquisition: None until a current official Polish manufacturer/importer source is identified.
locators.notes: Domain redirects through tracking to Ceneo; it is not acceptable first-party dealer evidence.

locators.notes: Correct brand is Daytona Motors; Dymoto 125 and Dymoto 125 X are Daytona model names, not a separate Dymoto marque. Official Polish distributor: MYMOTO Polska sp. z o.o.
